reviewedRiskGates.notes: Both scout PDFs are image/PDF extraction risks, and the official Dessert, Happy Hour, wine, beer, and cocktail pages contain menu images rather than accessible menu text.

Toast presents current food entries outside the frozen baseline, including Gazpacho, Hanger Steak, Seard Tuna Special, four additional desserts, and SD Grits; live/search representations also show non-baseline New York and an out-of-stock Braised Pork Shank state.
Current Toast-only food entries are present and the official image menu surfaces remain unenumerated.
Toast repeats featured products in their category listings; presentation-level duplication must not be interpreted as distinct products.
The only explicit global warning concerns raw/undercooked foods. No restaurant-issued cross-contact, shared-equipment, or may-contain disclosure was found; no cross-contact conclusion can be made.
Current scope is incomplete because restaurant-controlled menu pages are image-only and have not been text-enumerated; allergen authority is unavailable.
The independently observed allergen-disclosure gap and source-scope issues remain material.

Scout correctly recognized additional items but did not enumerate New York, shown as out of stock in current search evidence, and did not account for the unresolved restaurant-issued image-menu catalog. The group cannot carry complete allergen arrays.

findings.summary: Luna omitted six restaurant-controlled menu surfaces linked from Food & Drink. Their menu content is image-only in accessible text, leaving dessert, happy-hour, and beverage scope unresolved.

Luna used two aggregate catalog records rather than independently enumerating current products; it omitted the current Toast New York presentation and did not account for the unresolved official image-menu catalog.

No complete restaurant-issued allergen or ingredient source was found. Toast menu descriptions are restaurant-linked-vendor ingredient text and support only narrow named positives; they cannot support complete arrays, negatives, may-contain arrays, or cross-contact claims.

Braised Pork Shank and Pulled Brisket Sandwich were not present in the directly opened current Toast listing. The old official PDFs show different shank/brisket preparations and do not establish a current match.

summary: Independent verification confirms the Bethesda identity and accessible Toast dinner surface, but finds six additional restaurant-controlled image-menu surfaces and a missed Toast New York presentation. The current catalog is not fully enumerable and no authoritative complete allergen or cross-contact disclosure exists; the frozen items cannot support the existing complete allergen arrays or negative/cross-contact semantics.
